items.summary: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button. GA date: December CY2026

items.summary: In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence. #education GA date: December CY2026

items.summary: Bring Minecraft Education to every classroom with AI-powered tools that match curriculum goals to Build Challenges, blend lessons with project-based learning, launch directly from Learning Zone, and give you full visibility into participation, completion, and student understanding. #education GA dat

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Real-time queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile
items.summary: Calling representative and Supervisor leads can view real-time call queue metrics directly from the Queues app on Mobile, giving them greater visibility into current queue activity and performance while on the go. items.title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
items.summary: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY202

items.title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
items.summary: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Remember your online archive folder pane state
items.summary: Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
items.summary: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
items.summary: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Keep folder sharing within your organization's policies
items.summary: Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. cves.summary: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.
cves.kev_name: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability

cves.summary: The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.
cves.kev_name: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability

cves.summary: A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. cves.kev_name: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability

cves.summary: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce administrator-defined file type restrictions to restrict the file-types to be converted. This may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.
cves.kev_name: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability

cves.summary: Improper neutralization of shell metacharacters in the timezone configuration field in certain Barracuda appliance products using common Barracuda code allows an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed.
cves.kev_name: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability

cves.summary: An authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration.
cves.kev_name: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability

cves.summary: Use after free in XML in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.50 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)
Product ui does not warn user of unsafe actions in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
cves.kev_name: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability

cves.summary: GPUStack is an open-source GPU cluster manager for AI model serving and GPU instance provisioning. Prior to 2.2.0, get_current_user in gpustack/api/auth.py treated a loopback request source as the built-in administrator when force_auth_localhost was false, which was the default. A remote request could appear to originate from 127.0.0.1 because client_ip_getter accepted a same-host reverse proxy pe

sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. An example of a platform using musl libc without PAM is Alpine Linux.
cves.kev_name: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability

IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 could allow an authorized user to craft a specific message to bypass user authorization and gain full administrative privileges.
cves.kev_name: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability

PapaParse before 5.7.1 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to cause denial of service by submitting delimiter-free quoted CSV input to Papa.parse(). ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookWriter that allows attackers to read local files by supplying crafted image filenames to addImage. Attackers can inject ../ path segments into user-controlled image paths, causing addMedia to embed any file readable by the Node.js process under xl/media in the generated workbook.
